# sorobeacon_rule (Resource)

Manages a rule on a SoroBeacon monitor.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_id` (Number) Parent monitor ID.
- `params` (String) Rule parameters as a JSON string.
- `type` (String) Rule type (event_emitted, value_threshold, etc.).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
